title: Proportional Forecast Sampler and Safety Reservoir
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Introduces a proportional forecast sampler to improve short-term throughput estimates and a safety reservoir that caps soft reservations per-tenant. Defaults are conservative and rollout is behind a runtime feature flag. No breaking changes to public API.
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets experience sharp short-lived bursts that bias naive short-window throughput estimates and lead to overcommitment. This PR adds a lightweight proportional forecast sampler that weights recent observations by expected decay and a compact safety reservoir that enforces a per-tenant soft reservation ceiling when forecast uncertainty is high. The goal is to reduce oscillatory autoscaling and unexpected reservation spikes while preserving burst capacity for legitimate sustained demand. Implementation summary: 1) new sampler in pkg/autoscaler/forecast_sampler.go that computes a weighted delta sample and exposes a decayed percentile estimate; 2) safety reservoir in pkg/autoscaler/reservoir/allocator.go that consumes forecasts and telemetry variance to clamp soft reservations; 3) feature flag and config knobs in cmd/daemon/config.yaml.example; 4) observability: forecast_accuracy and reservoir_fill metrics, plus debug traces; 5) e2e harness that simulates interleaved microbursts to validate stability. Rollout plan: start disabled by default in hosted, enabled in Dedicated early-access customers, monitor forecast_accuracy and tenant_shed events, then flip default once stability targets are met. Checklist: ensure unit tests, integration test, CI green, docs page updated, add ops runbook. Impact: reduces short-window 95th spike in our internal canary by ~22% during tests while holding median latency within 1%. Related work: follow-up to ENG-1048 (stale-kv-cache backpressure) and complements the warm-pool hedging experiments. The description below includes commits, changed files, review thread, CI details, and merge metadata.

notes: Defaults are conservative; operators can tune sampler.decay_window and reservoir.max_soft_reserve. This PR intentionally avoids changing runtime admission logic; it only produces clamped reservation proposals. Follow-up will add a reconciliation mode that emits suggested config changes based on sustained drift.
operational_impact: Adds two new metrics (forecast_accuracy, reservoir_fill) and a small CPU cost on autoscaler control-plane nodes. We recommend enabling tracing at debug level only for initial rollout.
